title: A Rookies Guide to Watches
description:
Watches can be daunting to get into, so we put together this complete beginner's guide to watches: the vocabulary, how they work, the history of how we got here, and what to look for when buying your first one. They don't have to be expensive to be cool. We spent months on this. We went to Switzerland, talked to experts across the watch community, and even read TWO(!) books.

Big thanks to Tudor for having us out to their manufacture in Switzerland. Getting to see how these watches are actually made gave me even more respect for the craft and helped shaped a lot of this video. @TudorWatch 
https://tudorwatch.com

And a personal huge thank you to Cole Pennington 🙏 https://www.instagram.com/cole_pennington

And thank you to James Stacey @hodinkee for sharing his invaluable insights. Check his podcast out: https://thegreynato.com/ & https://www.instagram.com/jestacey

Post your watch on IG and tag me @JamesPumphrey !! I wanna see what you guys are wearing.
Check out everything else we've got going on: clothes, book club, Discord, and the membership program, at https://speeed.co

I love you!
